Read from the text that the ball reverses direction from +3 m/s to -2 m/s and the question asks when acceleration magnitude is greatest. Use the rule that acceleration is the slope dv/dt of a v-versus-t graph, so greatest acceleration magnitude occurs where the graph has the steepest slope in absolute value.
